entries.91ce6259c4c380d9: Within the logic semiconductor market, it is a fabless semiconductor vendor that develops and provides custom SoCs for each customer. To take advantage of the horizontal division of labor advancing in the semiconductor industry, it has no factories, and outsources product manufacturing to specialized manufacturers such as [[term:foundry|foundries]] including Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited (TSMC), and OSATs, which are contract manufacturing services for the [[term:back-end-process|back-end process]]. Revenue comes in 2 stages: at the design and development stage, it receives most of the costs required for design and development from customers in stages as NRE revenue, and at the mass production stage, it receives product revenue, which accounts for most of total revenue. Because it normally takes more than 2 years from winning a business opportunity until design and development and customer evaluation are completed and mass production begins, the company states that, as a company responsible for developing and supplying customers' core components over a long period, it conducts business on a solid financial foundation.

entries.dbd1261b9552e201: Socionext's business is a single [[term:segment|segment]] centered on SoCs developed under its 'Solution SoC' business model. ＳｏＣ (System on Chip) is a [[term:semiconductor|semiconductor]] chip that implements some or all of the functions required for the operation of a device or system in one chip. In conventional ASICs, upstream design such as architecture design, planning, specification design and logic design is performed by the customer itself; the feature of 'Solution SoC' is that Socionext performs this upstream design together with the customer. Its focus areas are automotive, data center/networking, smart devices and industrial, to which the ＩｏＴ＆radar sensing field, including radio-wave ranging sensors, is added. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥200,834 million.
